thread:
Emma Chen: FYI — KesselEdge's AWS Marketplace PO is in a weird state. Portal is rejecting it with a signer/timestamp error, provisioning stalled. Can someone take a look?

Raj Patel: Which PO ID? I can open a ticket with AWS marketplace support.

Emma Chen: PO ID 550-KE-9872. Error from portal: `SignerTimestampTTLExpired: signer timestamp 1723370000 outside allowed window (ttl 86400)`

Kevin O'Neal: Hmm — that usually means the partner's signing time is earlier/later than the portal expects. Did KesselEdge use their own signing system or standard DocuSign?

Emma Chen: They say they used DocuSign, but they also mentioned applying a local timezone offset. Partner success sent a PDF with a signature time of `2024-04-11T23:15:10-07:00`. Portal stored UTC and TTL check failed.

Marta Lopez: Legal: this is usually not a redline; it's a metadata mismatch. But we need the certified signature timestamp to match the PO payload the marketplace has. If we fudge timestamps we risk accounting/audit issues.

Raj Patel: Marketplace-bot just posted a notice: `PO Acceptance Window closes in 6h for 550-KE-9872` :alarm_clock:

marketplace-bot: Automatic notice: PO 550-KE-9872 acceptance window will expire at 1723490400.

Emma Chen: We need a short-term plan: either (A) get partner to re-sign with UTC timestamp (fast), (B) have AWS support accept manual override, or (C) reissue the PO from our side. Partner is pushing for (B).

Kevin O'Neal: I can try AWS support but manual overrides are rare mid-flow. Can we ask partner to re-sign? Might be faster. 

Emma Chen: KesselEdge just replied: "We can re-run signing now if you confirm the exact time window we need."

Marta Lopez: Ask them to sign within the last 2 hours of portal time (UTC). Also request full audit trail (DocuSign certificate) so Legal can accept it.

Raj Patel: Opening ticket with AWS Marketplace now — reference PO and include error snippet and partner DocuSign envelope id (if they provide it). I'll paste ticket link once created.

Emma Chen: Partner provided envelope id `env_KE_3344`. Dropped the DocuSign audit trail in the shared drive: https://redwood.app/share/ke-kesseledge/audit-trail.pdf

Kevin O'Neal: If partner can re-sign, momentum-wise that's quickest. But ask them to confirm the timestamp shows UTC. Provide them this instruction: `Please ensure DocuSign time zone = UTC, or attach the DocuSign certificate with timezone normalization`.

Marta Lopez: I'll standby for the audit trail. If AWS refuses override and partner won't re-sign within the acceptance window, Legal needs to confirm reissue process (may affect start date).

Raj Patel: AWS case created: https://support.aws.marketplace/case/6789123 — asked for manual acceptance or TTL relaxation. Case #6789123.

marketplace-bot: Update: PO 550-KE-9872 acceptance window currently 5h 42m.

Emma Chen: Quick ops checklist for owner assignment: Raj — AWS support. Kevin — communicate re-sign instructions to partner and verify envelope. Marta — review audit trail & confirm whether reissue affects contract effective date. I'll coordinate partner success.

Raj Patel: Ack. Will post progress in this thread.

KesselEdge (via partner success): Re-signing now, ETA ~12 minutes.

Emma Chen: :eyes: thanks. Once re-signed, Kevin — can you validate the timestamp and upload the certificate here?

Kevin O'Neal: Yep. I'll verify the envelope and confirm the UTC timestamp (or escalate).

marketplace-bot: Notice: PO 550-KE-9872 acceptance window updated: 4h 50m.

Emma Chen: If re-sign doesn't clear, fallback plan is to reissue the PO. Marta, if we reissue, will we need a contract amendment?

Marta Lopez: Probably not for a timestamp fix — operationally it's a new PO issuance. Legal prefers a short note tying the new PO to the original SOW. I'll draft the note template now.

Raj Patel: AWS support replied: "We're investigating but cannot guarantee acceptance. Please provide DocuSign envelope and audit trail." I forwarded the DocuSign link.

KesselEdge (via partner success): Re-signed. Envelope `env_KE_3344` updated at `2024-04-12T03:22:10Z`. Uploaded cert to shared drive.

Kevin O'Neal: Verified — timestamp is `2024-04-12T03:22:10Z` and within portal TTL. Uploaded verification screenshot: https://redwood.app/share/ke-kesseledge/verify-screenshot.png

marketplace-bot: PO 550-KE-9872 acceptance window now 3h 58m.

Emma Chen: AWS support just updated case: "We've accepted the evidence and processed the PO acceptance manually. Provisioning should resume within 15 minutes."

Raj Patel: Noted. I'll monitor.

KesselEdge (via partner success): Confirmed — instances provisioning. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:

Emma Chen: Great closure. Follow-ups: Kevin to store audit artifacts in partner folder, Marta to add a 1-paragraph legal note template, Raj to close AWS case when confirmed complete.

Kevin O'Neal: Will do.

Marta Lopez: Drafted note and uploaded: https://redwood.app/share/legal/kesseledge-note.txt

Raj Patel: AWS support closed case: #6789123 — "manual acceptance complete". Closing thread.

Emma Chen: :thumbsup: Thanks all — learned: ask partners to always sign with UTC or include normalized audit trail up front. I'll add a quick bullet to the Marketplace onboarding checklist.
